key_insight: LLM-guided feature optimization improves fleet-scale ranking models while respecting shared feature-pipeline budgets and per-model serving constraints.
engineering_relevance: The system helps large platforms balance ranking quality against feature costs and serving throughput across many production models.
method: LLM agents propose and shortlist cross features; deterministic tools execute and verify experiments.
Blend multiple feature-importance rankings, using Pareto fronts across tasks for multi-task models.
Tune feature selection through 10–25 asynchronous trials per model, then trim features to meet pipeline budgets.
evidence_signal: Across production models, the abstract reports a 0.31% average normalized-entropy improvement within budget, 2.3% lower pipeline cost after trimming without regression beyond measurement noise, and a 0.20% lift in a primary online A/B metric.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify fleet size, evaluation duration, or uncertainty estimates, limiting assessment of generalizability and statistical robustness.
paper_title: Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models
